description: The income statement, balance sheet or cash flow statement, as the company reports it with line items in reported order, for any fiscal year, quarter, year to date or trailing twelve months. `statement` picks one (default: every statement and table held for the period, including segments and industry metrics). `period` picks the periods (default: every period in the latest record: up to three fiscal years, the latest quarter and its prior-year comparative, year to date, trailing twelve months) and searches older records when the latest does not hold it; 'ttm' and 'ytd' return those blocks with their derivation notes. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held. Each period carries its dates, source form and accession. All money is in actual dollars (not thousands, not millions), per-share figures in dollars per share (per ADS for a foreign issuer that has one), share counts in actual shares, split-adjusted. A foreign issuer's figures are converted to US dollars at the rate recorded on each period. include_sources=true adds the sec.gov link for every figure the filing tags.

include_sources.description: Add a sec.gov link per tagged figure. Default false.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

statement.description: Which statement. Default 'all': every statement and table held for each period.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_statements
title: Statements for any period
